verdict.rationale: Docs reference a multimodal vision model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp) and a V4.1 Flash release with 'native multimodal support' on the API platform, and community confirms 'multimodal support now' making it usable as a primary model. However, this multimodal capability is scoped to image/vision only (no audio or document input evidence), is described as an experimental/limited release, and one community comment notes the flagship v4 is 'not multimodal native,' leaving the surface area unclear. Missing for 10: audio input support, document/file input support, and clear first-party docs stating full multimodal input scope across the main model line rather than a separate experimental vision variant.
